verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents an Uptime REST API with bearer-token auth. Its global token is described as valid 'for managing anything within Better Stack', but the only endpoints actually shown are monitor CRUD, and no incident acknowledge, escalate or resolve endpoint appears in the pack. The MCP server is pitched for telemetry (logs, metrics, traces) rather than incident actions, and the incident ack/resolve flows shown run through Slack or phone, so they don't count as an API path. Missing for 10: documented incident acknowledge/resolve API endpoints, an agent-triggered escalation endpoint, MCP tools for incident lifecycle actions, and hands-on corroboration of a dashboard-free workflow.
